subject: financial_literacy
concept: Making a simple choice between two things when you don't have enough money for both
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student is given a small play-money budget and two items to choose between, and makes a choice
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a limited budget to which combination of items it can and can't afford
exercise.abstract: Student explains why they chose one item over another given a limited amount of money

misconception_flags: selects a combination of items that exceeds the given budget

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
